Name: Hot Air Balloon Obelisks
Author: zilchaz
Description:
Change all obelisks (including [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2571]Deepwoods[/url] obelisk) to the hot air balloons floating on your farm.

Except for obelisks, this mod also including animated vanilla Gold Clock, by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/75703183]PaulDunstan[/url], it'll be shimmering on a sunny or windy day.

[size=2][img]https://imgur.com/NgTY1vl.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*]You need to install the latest version of  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url]﻿.
[*]Drop the content of this zip file in your mod folder: [i]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/i]
[/list]
[size=2][img]https://i.imgur.com/BYF6VV0.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*]You can enable/disabled each Obelisk and Gold Clock in[i] config.json[/i] ("true" by default)
[*]If you don't want animation, you can disabled "Animation" to "false" ("true" by default)
[/list]
...

Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/75703183]PaulDunstan[/url] for making all Hot Air Balloons animation!
